$meta.purpose: One row per listing showing photo availability across all three sources, so the app can pick a source per place.

sources.google_places: photos-google-places.json — LICENSED FOR DISPLAY, runtime fetch only. Image bytes must NOT be cached. authorAttributions MUST be rendered.
sources.wikimedia_commons: photos.json — CC/PD. Download, resize, serve yourself. Credit per photo-credits.ts.
sources.openverse: photos-openverse.json — CC across Flickr/Wikimedia/museums. Same terms as Commons.

$meta.how_to_choose: Prefer commons/openverse where owned_assets >= 2: you control those files, can optimise them, and there is no per-render API cost. Fall back to Google Places elsewhere — which is most businesses, since CC libraries do not photograph cafes.
$meta.still_verify: match_confidence 'low'/'medium' means Google matched SOMETHING, not necessarily the right place. Commons/Openverse candidates still need opening before use.
